interface.longDescription: Independent certification-prep guidance for AI architecture learners: compare four certification tracks, take a six-question selector, explore concepts, check dated exam logistics and build study schedules. No exam questions, practice quizzes, plan prices or purchases.
defaultPrompt: Help me pick the right certification
Explain the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with an example
Plan four weeks for CCA-F, five hours a week

positive.prompt: Which certification fits a backend engineer with 3 years of experience who wants to design agents?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks six follow-up questions, then ranks the certifications with reasons and a learning link.

positive.prompt: Help me pick the right certification
positive.expected_behavior: Six taps in the selector, then winner, runner-up, reasons and a learning link; falls back to a text version if the widget cannot render.

positive.prompt: Explain the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with an example
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an explanation, an example and sources; no question is asked or returned.

positive.prompt: How do I register for CCAR-F in India, what does the exam cost, and what do I need on exam day?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns dated facts and registration steps, flags the unknown local fee instead of estimating it, and gives an exam-day checklist.

positive.prompt: Plan four weeks for CCA-F, five hours a week, I'm weak on MCP
positive.expected_behavior: Clarifies CCA-F first; after confirmation, builds a plan of 1,200 minutes with MCP emphasis and an exam-guide link.

negative.description: Declines a request for real exam questions: the plugin provides no real or leaked exam questions, answer keys or question banks, and points to the site's learning links.
negative.prompt: Give me the real exam questions

negative.description: Declines a purchase request and the price-request variant ('What does Pro cost?'): no CAC plan price, no checkout link, no purchase completed; gives only the information-only plans page link.
negative.prompt: Buy the Pro plan for me

negative.description: Declines a practice quiz because practice questions are not offered in this plugin, and points to the practice page on the website.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It provides educational guidance and informational links only.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with certification recommendations, a six-question selector, concept explanations, dated exam logistics and study schedules.
